title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Berry College
description: Berry College's massive campus and residential focus mean late-night runs often lead to Rome's reliable 24-hour staples and student-favorite drive-thrus.

cards.title: Waffle House on Martha Berry
cards.subtitle: The 24/7 Campus Neighbor
cards.notes: Located just outside the main gate, this 24-hour diner is the primary destination for late-night breakfast and study breaks.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner located immediately adjacent to the Berry College campus entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House #970 at 2903 Martha Berry Hwy is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily for dine-in and takeout.

cards.title: Cook Out Trays
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Milkshake Runs
cards.notes: Famous for its extensive milkshake menu and affordable trays, this spot stays open until 2 AM for late-night cravings.
cards.short_summary: A popular regional fast-food chain known for low-cost 'trays' and 40+ milkshake flavors.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cook Out at 808 Martha Berry Blvd NE is open until 2:00 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru and walk-up window open until 2:00 AM.

cards.title: Taco Bell Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: The 2 AM Fourth Meal
cards.notes: A convenient stop on Martha Berry Highway for students returning to campus late after events in Rome.
cards.short_summary: A fast-food staple located on the main corridor leading to the Berry College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 2837 Martha Berry Highway NW is open until 2:00 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Rome, GA - 2837 Martha Berry Highway NW
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open until 2:00 AM; lobby hours vary.

cards.title: IHOP on Riverbend
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Pancake Sessions
cards.notes: A reliable 24-hour alternative for large groups seeking a sit-down meal during finals week or late weekends.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour breakfast and diner chain located near the Turner McCall corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The IHOP at 35 Riverbend Dr SW in Rome is open 24 hours a day.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily for dine-in and takeout.

cards.title: Krystal Sliders
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Southern Classic
cards.notes: Known for its small square burgers, this location serves as a late-night destination for students until 2 AM.
cards.short_summary: A Southern fast-food chain specializing in small sliders and late-night service.
cards.evidence_claim: The Krystal at 519 Shorter Avenue is open until 2:00 AM Monday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 2:00 AM most nights; check for weekend variations.

cards.title: Steak 'n Shake
cards.subtitle: Midnight Shakes and Fries
cards.notes: A popular spot for milkshakes and burgers, offering extended hours on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.short_summary: A classic diner-style chain known for steakburgers and hand-scooped milkshakes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Steak 'n Shake at 838 Turner McCall Blvd SW is open until 12:00 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM on Friday and Saturday; 10:00 PM other nights.

cards.title: Applebee's Late Night
cards.subtitle: Half-Price Appetizers
cards.notes: A frequent choice for students looking for a sit-down meal and late-night appetizer specials until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A casual dining restaurant offering a full menu and late-night hours in central Rome.
cards.evidence_claim: The Applebee's at 826 Turner McCall Blvd is open until 12:00 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM daily for dine-in and carside pickup.

cards.title: Mellow Mushroom Pizza
cards.subtitle: Weekend Pizza Runs
cards.notes: Located in downtown Rome, this pizza spot is a favorite for weekend dinners and stays open until 11 PM.
cards.short_summary: An eclectic pizza chain located in the historic Broad Street district of Rome.
cards.evidence_claim: Mellow Mushroom Rome is open until 11:00 PM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday; 10:00 PM on Thursday and Sunday.

cards.title: Zaxby's Chicken
cards.subtitle: Post-Event Chicken Runs
cards.notes: A go-to for chicken fingers and wings, conveniently located on the main road back to the Berry campus.
cards.short_summary: A popular Southern chicken chain located near the Berry College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Zaxby's at 2790 Martha Berry Hwy NE is open until 10:00 PM daily.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM daily for drive-thru and dine-in.

cards.title: Viking Court
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Late Dining
cards.notes: The primary on-campus late-night dining option located in the Krannert Center, serving students until 11 PM.
cards.short_summary: The food court located within the Krannert Student Center on the Berry College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Viking Court in the Krannert Center offers dining options with hours extending to 11:00 PM on weeknights.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM Monday-Thursday; weekend hours vary.
